correctness.rationale: Dirichlet-inverse Euler factor (1-X)(1-pX) gives local values -(p+1), p, and zero at e>=3. Prime inputs vanish for all t. At n=1 P_t=4+2t >0 for t>-2. Squarefree composite parity gives strict positive for even number of primes and negative for odd >=3. Prime-cube multiples give phi(n)+2+t>0. For cube-free nonsquarefree n=a b² with squarefree coprime a,b and b>1, exact expression b[mu(a)sigma(a)+phi(a)phi(b)]+2+t uses integral T; when T>=0 it is positive, when T<0 and b>=3 negative for t<1; b=2 forces a odd and T<=-2 by even divisibility. The endpoint witnesses n1 at t=-2 and n18 at t=1 are exact. An independent exact integer implementation verified n<=20000 at four rational interior values. Classification concerns maximal connected open interval about 0, not all disjoint parameter sets.
